documents.doc-cz-uoou-2026-08-26-uoou-05841-26-3: The Czech Office for Personal Data Protection stated that the Supreme Public Prosecutor’s Office sent the appeal and the case file on 12 August 2026, but they were not received by the Office until 17 August 2026. According to the Office, the fifteen-day period under Section 16(3) of the Freedom of Information Act therefore runs from that delivery and expires on 1 September 2026. The Office also stated that no procedural act had yet been taken in the appeal proceedings and that the separate submission of 14 July 2026, supplemented on 12 August 2026, would be handled by the competent department in a separate letter.
